0022600221.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-4, 3-2 on the road) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, 5-0 on the road) with Denver sitting 10th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Northwest, while Memphis is 6th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Southwest and riding a one-game winning streak. The Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-119 regular-season win in Denver on April 8, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Julian Strawther (knee sprain) is out for Denver, while Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Quinten Post (head) are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
